lede.en: Scored without the two aspects this crawl could not read fairly, GEMS-Taiwan takes the second finalist slot at 4.21, behind Hong Kong-JSS (4.28) and 0.06 clear of Korea-HS. Only one team scores above us. But the lead is thinner than it looks: the skeptic's evidence corrections, which are not about documentation, drop us to sixth, and the single reason is that our Results banner claims a light switch our own figures do not show.
lede.zh: 排除本次爬蟲無法公平評分的兩個面向後，GEMS-Taiwan 以 4.21 拿下第二個決賽名額，落後 Hong Kong-JSS（4.28），領先 Korea-HS 0.06 分。分數高於我們的只有一隊。但這個領先比看起來脆弱：唱反調審查員的證據修正（與文件無關）會讓我們掉到第六，唯一的原因就是我們 Results 頁宣稱的光開關，自己的圖並沒有顯示。

method_extra.en: Known limits of this run. The screening scores were compressed (many teams between 3.9 and 4.25), so the cut-off fell inside a cluster near 3.9; a few teams just below it (for example UCS-B, Beijing-HS, NACIS Shanghai, Institut Le Rosey) were not read in full. The judges could not open the Registry, so part documentation was scored from wiki tables. Two aspects were dropped from the combined score after judging, for the reasons given above; the per-aspect tables still show them so the original reading stays visible.
method_extra.zh: 本次評估的已知限制。篩選分數偏集中（許多隊落在 3.9–4.25），因此門檻落在 3.9 附近的一群隊伍中間；略低於門檻的幾隊（例如 UCS-B、Beijing-HS、NACIS Shanghai、Institut Le Rosey）沒有被完整閱讀。評審無法開啟 Registry，元件文件是依 wiki 上的表格評分。評分後有兩個面向因上述原因從綜合分數中移除；各面向表格仍然顯示它們，以保留原始評分。

verdict.en:
HongKong-JSS leads because its central claim is the only one in the field that was replicated. The mercury biosensor was characterised in five independent matched runs, every assessed treatment beat its matched control in both readouts, selectivity against lead, zinc and cadmium was quantified, a calibration model was fitted on four runs and tested on two withheld ones, and a self-built instrument reproduced the dose response independently. All three judges placed it first. That is a narrow project, one analyte and one readout, but what it claims, it shows.

Our second place is now clear rather than tied, and it is worth being honest about why. Dropping aspect 6 and wiki aspect 4 removed two deductions that were artifacts of what a text crawl can read, and we were among the teams they hurt. But the same change removed credit from the teams we were tied with. Korea-HS published per-member task attribution and an explicit AI-use statement on its wiki, and SMS-Shenzhen did the same; both now lose that. Korea-HS was also the only team in the top six whose notebook was readable HTML rather than an embedded PDF, so it was effectively being rewarded for file format. Our 0.06 lead over it rests partly on no longer counting things it did better than us.

Where we gain: scale and engineering depth beat every team here. Twelve-plus documented DBTL cycles where failures visibly changed the next build, four built instruments, plant rescue in three systems with mock and plasmid-free controls at n = 9-40, secreted ACC deaminase shown by three orthogonal assays and active in cell-free shell permeate at 6-8 U/mg through 72 h, and a pre-registered growth-rate prediction written down on 1 October and scored thirteen days later. The provenance ledger, the retained failures and the published disagreement between two of our own pages on payback were all credited by three judges as honesty.

Where we lose, and this is the part no documentation fix touches: on whether the project worked we score 3.83, behind HongKong-JSS at 4.5 and Korea-HS at 4.0. The optogenetic switch is not demonstrated. ELISA is flat under green and red alike, DNPH inverts between 13 h and 16 h, and red exceeded green at 8 h in the pre-cultured set, while the Results banner still says green light switches ACCD on. Several load-bearing numbers are n = 1, including the secreted-activity figure that feeds the dose model and both containment platings. No forecast has driven a light and no light-driven culture has reached the reactor.

The skeptic is where our second place actually fails. Its corrections are about evidence, not paperwork, so they survive this re-scoring: roughly -0.08 against us for the unsupported headline claim. Applying them drops us to sixth, behind Korea-HS, PSI Korea, GreatBay-SCIE and HangzhouFourteenAP, while HongKong-JSS stays first and in fact gains, because the deduction against it was for having done no cloning at all, which is exactly the kind of judgement aspect 6 carried.

Two teams to watch that the first read buried. GreatBay-SCIE moves from twelfth to fifth on this correction, with a project mean identical to ours, and PSI Korea from seventh to fourth. Neither was weak; both were documented in ways the crawl could not read. If real judges open the attribution form and the notebook PDFs, which they will, the field above and around us is more crowded than the first read suggested.

The honest limits. The presentation video and the judging-session Q&A are not assessed here, and several of the open questions against our wiki, including which page we stand behind on the light switch, are exactly the kind Q&A resolves in a team's favour. The handbook does not publish aspect weights, so the combined figures are this panel's weighting, not iGEM's. The Registry was unreachable for all three judges, so part documentation is scored from wiki tables throughout. This is a prediction, not a result.

So: first place is robust, our second place is real on these numbers but rests on a correction that cuts both ways, and it does not survive the skeptic. One aspect decides it, and it is not the paperwork. Fix the Results banner so it matches the figures, replicate the n = 1 results that carry the dose model, and the second slot is genuinely in play.
verdict.zh:
HongKong-JSS 居首，是因為它的核心主張是全場唯一做過重複驗證的。那個汞生物感測器做了五次獨立的配對實驗，每個受測處理在兩種讀值上都勝過自己的配對對照，對鉛、鋅、鎘的選擇性都有量化，校正模型用四次實驗建立、再用另外兩次保留實驗測試，還有一台自製儀器獨立重現了劑量反應曲線。三位評審都把它排第一。這是個範圍很窄的專案，一個分析物、一種讀值，但它宣稱什麼，就拿得出什麼。

我們的第二名現在是單獨第二、不再是並列，但要誠實說明原因。移除第 6 項與 Wiki 第 4 項，拿掉了兩個因文字爬蟲讀不到而產生的扣分，我們確實是被這兩項扣到的隊伍之一。但同一個改動也拿掉了原本與我們同分那些隊伍的加分。Korea-HS 在 wiki 上逐一列出每位成員的分工，還有明確的 AI 使用聲明，SMS-Shenzhen 也是，這些現在都不算了。而且 Korea-HS 是前六名中唯一 notebook 是可讀 HTML、而非嵌入式 PDF 的隊伍，等於先前是因為檔案格式而被加分。我們領先它的 0.06 分，有一部分建立在「不再計入它做得比我們好的地方」。

我們的強項：專案份量與工程深度勝過這裡任何一隊。十二輪以上有記錄的 DBTL 循環，而且失敗確實改變了下一次的建構；四台自製儀器；三個系統的植物救援實驗，有 mock 與無質體對照，n = 9–40；分泌型 ACC deaminase 以三種互相獨立的方法證實，並在無細胞的殼側濾液中維持 6–8 U/mg 達 72 小時；還有一個 10 月 1 日寫下、13 天後才比對的預先登記生長率預測。來源追溯表、保留下來的失敗紀錄，以及我們自己兩個頁面對回收年限的公開分歧，三位評審都把這些算成誠實加分。

我們的弱項，而且這部分補文件完全沒用：「是否成功」我們是 3.83，落後 HongKong-JSS 的 4.5 與 Korea-HS 的 4.0。光控開關沒有被證明。ELISA 在綠光與紅光下一樣平；DNPH 在 13 到 16 小時之間反轉；預培養那組在第 8 小時紅光還高於綠光，但 Results 頁開頭仍然寫著「綠光開啟 ACCD」。好幾個關鍵數字是 n = 1，包括餵進劑量模型的分泌活性數值，以及兩次圍堵性平盤實驗。而且沒有任何一次預測真的驅動過光源，也沒有任何光驅動的培養進到反應器。

真正讓我們的第二名站不住的是唱反調審查員。它的修正針對的是證據、不是文件，所以在這次重新計分後依然成立：對我們大約 −0.08，理由是那個沒有證據支持的核心主張。套用之後我們掉到第六，落後 Korea-HS、PSI Korea、GreatBay-SCIE 與 HangzhouFourteenAP；而 HongKong-JSS 不但維持第一，分數還上升，因為原本對它的扣分是「完全沒有自己做選殖」，那正是第 6 項在承擔的判斷。

有兩隊是第一次評估埋掉、現在要盯住的。GreatBay-SCIE 經這次修正後從第 12 名升到第 5 名，專題平均與我們完全相同；PSI Korea 從第 7 升到第 4。這兩隊都不弱，只是文件的發布方式讓爬蟲讀不到。如果真正的評審打開貢獻歸屬表與 notebook PDF（他們會打開），我們上方與周圍的競爭，比第一次評估看起來的還要擁擠。

誠實的限制。簡報影片與評審場的問答沒有納入評分，而針對我們 wiki 的幾個未解問題，包括光開關那件事我們到底以哪一頁為準，正好是問答最可能幫隊伍扳回來的那一類。手冊沒有公布各面向的權重，所以這裡的綜合分數是本評審團的權重，不是 iGEM 的。三位評審都連不上 Registry，所以元件文件全程是依 wiki 上的表格評分。這是預測，不是結果。

結論：第一名很穩；我們的第二名在這組數字下是真的，但建立在一個雙面刃的修正上，而且撐不過唱反調審查員。決定勝負的是同一個面向，而那個面向不是文件。把 Results 頁的說法改成與圖一致，把撐住劑量模型的那些 n = 1 結果補上重複，第二個名額才真的有機會。
